text:
li: Quick follow-up from the multi-region sync. Ops wants a compact, machine-evaluable switchback orchestration that: (a) prevents split-brain, (b) never violates residency, and (c) gives clear telemetry for postmortems. Short proposal below.

omar: TL;DR: require three boolean gates per-tenant: safety_ok && policy_ok && cooldown_ok. Safety comes from runtime; policy from control plane; cooldown blocks oscillation. Auto-switchback only if all true and stable for 60s.

zara: Runtime signals we can provide today: runtime.last_applied_seq{tenant,region}, runtime.inflight_leases{tenant,region}, runtime.ingress_queue_len{tenant,region}, runtime.state_hash{tenant,region}. New: emit state_hash as sha256 over deterministic keys (configurable key prefix). Safety rule: (seq_delta <= 1 for 60s OR state_hash_match==true) AND inflight_leases==0 AND ingress_queue_len==0 AND time_skew < 500ms.

li: Example emitted event (for logs/metrics pipeline) that ops asked for: 
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-corp",
  "ts": "2026-04-10T15:12:30Z",
  "candidate_region": "eu-west-1",
  "primary_region": "us-east-1",
  "seq_primary": "543210",
  "seq_candidate": "543209",
  "seq_delta": 1,
  "state_hash_primary": "a1b2...f3",
  "state_hash_candidate": "a1b2...f3",
  "inflight_leases": 0,
  "ingress_queue_len": 0,
  "time_skew_ms": 120,
  "safety_ok": true,
  "policy_ok": false,
  "cooldown_ok": true,
  "switchback_allowed": false,
  "reason": "policy_block_residency"
}
```

omar: Control-plane flags needed: tenant.residency_mode={hard,preferred,none}, tenant.allow_cross_region_writes (bool), tenant.auto_switchback_mode={auto,manual,disabled}, tenant.switchback_cooldown_minutes. For tenants with nondeterministic side-effects add tenant.requires_deterministic_replay=true -> default auto_switchback=disabled.

zara: Dashboard/metrics: expose composite metric switchback.gate{tenant,region}=0/1 and label reason; counters switchback.attempts_total and switchback.fail_reasons_total; gauge last_switchback_ts and switchback_cooldown_until. Add a heatmap for seq_delta vs time-since-failover.

li: Minimal runbook snippet for SRE (copy/paste):
- confirm tenant.residency_mode and tenant.allow_cross_region_writes
- confirm switchback.gate==1 for >=60s
- confirm inflight_leases==0 and ingress_queue_len==0
- run deterministic canary: 3 idempotent read/writes against candidate region and compare state_hash
- flip primary and set tenant.switchback_cooldown_until = now + tenant.switchback_cooldown_minutes
- monitor error rate and tail latency for 10m; revert if >2% error or tail latency spike

ops-bot: notice: observed failover for tenant=acme-corp at 2026-04-10T15:09:10Z; duration=18m; seq_delta=3; state_hash_match=false; switchback_allowed=false; reason=state_mismatch

sre-bot: notice: policy flag tenant=acme-corp residency_mode=hard; auto_switchback_mode=disabled (legal block)
